prompt:
Ultra-realistic full-body editorial fashion photograph of a handsome young man in his early 20s, completely original person, with a naturally attractive realistic face, thick slightly wavy jet-black hair, strong eyebrows, deep dark-brown eyes, straight defined nose, prominent cheekbones, sharp masculine jawline, and subtle natural stubble.
He stands casually in the center of a minimalist studio, looking slightly downward with a soft confident smile, both hands relaxed inside his trouser pockets, one leg slightly crossed in a natural effortless pose.
He wears a dark navy-blue oversized linen shirt, slightly unbuttoned at the chest with sleeves casually rolled up, paired with loose-flowing white linen trousers and a sophisticated silver wristwatch. Elegant, masculine, understated luxury fashion.
The background is a soft warm-gray textured plaster wall with gentle diffused studio lighting and subtle shadows. Surround the subject with an artistic vertical paint-dripping / ink-streak effect, beginning around the shoulders and extending downward along the silhouette. The streaks should look like fine wet paint or charcoal lines, creating a fashion-editorial “melting photograph" effect, while the man's face and upper body remain extremely sharp and photorealistic.
Natural skin pores, realistic hair strands, detailed fabric texture, accurate anatomy, realistic hands, cinematic lighting, high-end fashion magazine photography, sophisticated composition, muted neutral color palette, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8K, vertical portrait, 9:16.
Negative prompt: cartoon, anime, CGI look, plastic skin, overly muscular body, distorted face, bad hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, duplicate body, blurry face, unnatural eyes, excessive retouching, text, watermark, logo, signature.
